If something like Gavin & Stacey ran for 10 Seasons with a total of ~240 Episodes, it couldve been one of the biggest tv shows in history, it even went on for 17 years technically!
So people on both sides of the pond, would you want something that’s British written set in The States or something British, go on for hundreds of episodes?
